list.name: vin
list.label: VIN
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vin AS __text, vin AS __value FROM telemetry ORDER BY 1

list.name: dist_effective
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '$dist_unit'='metric' THEN 'metric' WHEN '$dist_unit'='imperial' THEN 'imperial' WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(distance_unit, 'DistanceUnitKm') FROM vehicle_prefs_pivot WHERE vin = '$vin')='DistanceUnitMiles' THEN 'imperial' ELSE 'metric' END

list.name: temp_effective
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN '$temp_unit'='fahrenheit' THEN 'imperial' WHEN '$temp_unit'='celsius' THEN 'metric' WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(temp_unit, 'TemperatureUnitC') FROM vehicle_prefs_pivot WHERE vin = '$vin')='TemperatureUnitFahrenheit' THEN 'imperial' ELSE 'metric' END

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", model_year AS "Year", motor_config AS "Motor", has_heat_pump AS "Heat Pump", has_air_suspension AS "Air Suspension" FROM detect_vehicle_from_vin('$vin')

panels.title: Decoded VIN: $vin
panels.description: Vehicle information decoded from the selected VIN using the detect_vehicle_from_vin() database function.

panels.title: AC Energy In (30d)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, delta)), 0) AS kwh
FROM (
  SELECT num_value - LAG(num_value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS delta
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE field='ACChargingEnergyIn' AND vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
) d

panels.description: Total AC charging energy added over the last 30 days.

panels.title: DC Energy In (30d)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, delta)), 0) AS kwh
FROM (
  SELECT num_value - LAG(num_value) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS delta
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE field='DCChargingEnergyIn' AND vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
) d

panels.description: Total DC fast-charging energy added over the last 30 days.

panels.title: Regen (derived, 30d)
panels.description: Regen kWh = ∫ max(0, -Power) dt. No dedicated regen field is streamed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, -power_kw)) * 30.0/3600.0, 0) AS kwh
FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('30s', v.ts) AS b,
    AVG(v.num_value) * AVG(i.num_value) / 1000 AS power_kw
  FROM telemetry v
  JOIN telemetry i ON time_bucket('30s', v.ts) = time_bucket('30s', i.ts) AND v.vin = i.vin
  WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
    AND v.vin='$vin' AND v.ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1
) p

panels.title: Drive Energy (derived, 30d)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, power_kw)) * 30.0/3600.0, 0) AS kwh
FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('30s', v.ts) AS b,
    AVG(v.num_value) * AVG(i.num_value) / 1000 AS power_kw
  FROM telemetry v
  JOIN telemetry i ON time_bucket('30s', v.ts) = time_bucket('30s', i.ts) AND v.vin = i.vin
  WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
    AND v.vin='$vin' AND v.ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1
) p

panels.description: Estimated drive energy consumed over the last 30 days, derived from pack power.

panels.title: Distance (30d)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN '$dist_effective'='imperial' THEN COALESCE(MAX(num_value) - MIN(num_value), 0) ELSE COALESCE(MAX(num_value) - MIN(num_value), 0)*1.60934 END)::numeric, 1) AS dist FROM telemetry WHERE field='Odometer' AND vin='$vin' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

panels.description: Total distance driven over the last 30 days, derived from odometer deltas.

panels.title: Power

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  v.bucket AS time,
  v.avg_v * i.avg_v / 1000 AS power_kw
FROM telemetry_1m v
JOIN telemetry_1m i ON v.bucket = i.bucket AND v.vin = i.vin
WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
  AND v.vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(v.bucket)
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Battery power over time, calculated from pack voltage × pack current.

panels.title: State of Charge

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, last_v AS soc FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='BatteryLevel' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Battery state of charge trend over the selected time range.

panels.title: Charge Curve (Power vs SoC, last 7d)
panels.description: Pairs Power and BatteryLevel within each charge session — typical fast-charge taper.

targets.rawSql:
WITH soc AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS m, AVG(num_value) AS soc
  FROM telemetry WHERE vin='$vin' AND field='BatteryLevel' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY 1
),
pwr AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', v.ts) AS m, AVG(v.num_value)*AVG(i.num_value)/1000 AS kw
  FROM telemetry v
  JOIN telemetry i ON time_bucket('1 minute', v.ts)=time_bucket('1 minute',i.ts) AND v.vin=i.vin
  WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
    AND v.vin='$vin' AND v.ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING AVG(v.num_value)*AVG(i.num_value)/1000 < -1
)
SELECT s.soc, ABS(p.kw) AS power_kw FROM soc s JOIN pwr p ON s.m=p.m ORDER BY s.soc

panels.title: Drive efficiency by speed bucket (Wh/km, 30d)

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', v.ts) AS m,
    AVG(v.num_value)*AVG(i.num_value)/1000 AS power_kw
  FROM telemetry v
  JOIN telemetry i ON time_bucket('1 minute',v.ts)=time_bucket('1 minute',i.ts) AND v.vin=i.vin
  WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
    AND v.vin='$vin' AND v.ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1
),
s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS m, AVG(num_value) AS mph
  FROM telemetry WHERE vin='$vin' AND field='VehicleSpeed'
    AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  width_bucket(s.mph, 0, 80, 8)*10 AS speed_mph_bucket,
  AVG(GREATEST(0,p.power_kw)/NULLIF(s.mph*1.609,0)*1000) AS wh_per_km
FROM p JOIN s ON p.m=s.m WHERE s.mph > 5
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average energy consumption grouped by 10 mph speed buckets over the last 30 days.

panels.title: Charge Sessions

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, started, ended, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM duration)/60 AS minutes FROM charge_sessions WHERE vin='$vin' AND started > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY started DESC

panels.description: List of recent charge sessions with start, end, and duration.

panels.title: Driving activity (14d × 24h, avg drive power)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', v.ts) AS time,
  GREATEST(0, AVG(v.num_value)*AVG(i.num_value)/1000) AS power_kw
FROM telemetry v
JOIN telemetry i ON time_bucket('30s',v.ts)=time_bucket('30s',i.ts) AND v.vin=i.vin
WHERE v.field='PackVoltage' AND i.field='PackCurrent'
  AND v.vin='$vin' AND v.ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Heatmap of average drive power by hour of day over the last 14 days.

panels.title: Pack temperature spread (min / max)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, to_temp(avg_v, '$temp_effective') AS min_c FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='ModuleTempMin' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, to_temp(avg_v, '$temp_effective') AS max_c FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='ModuleTempMax' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Minimum and maximum battery module temperatures over time.

panels.title: Pack voltage / current

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_v AS voltage FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='PackVoltage' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1
SELECT bucket AS time, avg_v AS current FROM telemetry_1m WHERE field='PackCurrent' AND vin='$vin' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Battery pack voltage and current over the selected time range.

panels.title: Lifetime Energy Used
panels.description: Total lifetime energy consumed by the vehicle (kWh).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts as time, num_value as value FROM telemetry_latest WHERE vin='$vin' AND field='LifetimeEnergyUsed'

panels.title: Charge Rate
panels.description: Miles of range added per hour while charging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts as time, CASE WHEN '$dist_effective'='imperial' THEN num_value ELSE num_value*1.60934 END as value FROM telemetry WHERE field='ChargeRateMilePerHour' AND vin='$vin' AND num_value IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
